People have been conditioned in our society not to expose too much and to avoid seeming vulnerable. Customers embrace these mores by masking their real wants with superficial needs.

units.source_en: People have been conditioned in our society not to expose too much and to avoid seeming vulnerable.
Customers embrace these mores by masking their real wants with superficial needs.

paragraphs.source_en: The best way to understand this concept is through the dichotomy of explicit needs and implicit needs. Explicit needs are those needs most commonly expressed by customers when asked what they are looking for. Some examples of explicit needs include improving service or quality, growing the market share, and reducing overhead. These needs tend to be based on mea-surable factors such as price or percentage, but they do not go to the heart of why customers do what they do. For that, we must look at implicit needs.

paragraphs.source_en: 3\. *Recognition.* This is the need to feel valued as a worker and to feel that your opinions matter.
